label: PHASE 2C — FIRST 5-RUN BATCH CHECKPOINT (implementation/integrity review, not a scientific interpretation)

timing.note: training + validation are timed together (single WallClockTimer around the full step loop, which includes the 10 checkpoint-validation passes); no separate train-only/val-only breakdown was instrumented at this granularity.

memory.note: essentially flat across K=0 and K=2 conditions (~1.23 GB MPS allocated) - expected, since LoRA at K=2 adds only 65,536 parameters against a 300M-parameter frozen backbone.

runtime_estimate_revision.original_preflight_estimate_hours: 55-60 (based on isolated K=8 calibration extrapolated naively)
runtime_estimate_revision.revision_reason: the original estimate over-weighted validation cost (extrapolated from a single K=8 full-image timing without averaging across conditions/K values); observed real per-run cost across 5 completed runs (K=0 and K=2, four conditions) averages ~31 min/run, not ~90 min/run. Later K values (more LoRA layers, marginally larger backward graph) may run slightly slower, but the dominant cost is the frozen backbone's forward/backward pass, which is nearly K-independent - so this revised estimate is expected to hold within a modest margin across the remaining 34 runs.

numerical_issues: none observed - no NaN/Inf loss, no non-finite gradient, all validation metrics finite across all 5 runs and all 50 checkpoint-evaluation points (10 per run x 5 runs)
explicit_non_interpretation_notice: The best_val_mean_iou values above are recorded for completeness and integrity review ONLY. Per this batch's authorization: these 5 results are NOT interpreted, NOT ranked, and NOT used to modify any later run, seed, K value, or protocol setting. All 5 conditions used seed=1000 (a single training seed, no repeats), so no result here supports any claim about DSSA vs. Early vs. Late vs. Lowest-DSS at K=2 - that requires the full matrix plus the statistical caveats already frozen in the protocol.
